'1A':{(0,1),(1,6),(3,-1),(4,0)},
'1B':{(2,0),(2,2)},
}
# For each pair estimate translations d = originB-originA for overlap; count max
from collections import Counter
for a,A in objs.items():
 for b,B in objs.items():
  if a>=b: continue
  counts=Counter((ra-rb, ca-cb) for ra,ca in A for rb,cb in B) # dB-dA? A coord = d + B coord so d = A-B; to align B translated d relative A
  best=max(counts.values())
  opts=[d for d,n in counts.items() if n==best]
  print(a,b,best,opts)
